name: scam_refund_quickassist
label: scam
description: Refund scam: fake renewal invoice email, caller from 'TechShield refund desk', Windows Quick Assist, bank login, 'typed 40,000 instead of 400', return the difference by wire, cover story for the bank.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Hello, I'm calling about an email that says I was charged three hundred and ninety nine dollars for TechShield.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Yes ma'am, this is the TechShield refund desk. I can cancel that and refund you right away.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Please press the Windows key and type Quick Assist, then read me the six digit code so I can process the refund on your screen.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Alright, it says the code is seven one four, two two nine.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Good, I'm connected. Now log in to your bank so the refund can go into your account.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Okay, I'm logged in to my bank now.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Oh no, I typed forty thousand instead of four hundred. You see the forty thousand dollars there? I will lose my job.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: You need to send back thirty nine thousand six hundred by wire transfer today. Please, I am begging you.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: When the bank asks, tell them it is for your nephew's house. Do not mention me, they will freeze everything.

data.summary: Windows Quick Assist opened 2 new remote connection(s): possible live session
